brief_summary: Four-row comparison ladder of component-level sensor specs, Hall-effect versus TMR: sensitivity, noise floor, dynamic range, and bare-sensor power draw. Three rows highlight the TMR cell in coral (sensitivity, noise floor, power draw); the dynamic-range row highlights the Hall-effect cell instead, since Hall tolerates a wider field range before saturating.
